answer_1.quote: We also consider several natural language generation (NLG) tasks including two translation tasks from Flores200, one question answering task SQuAD v2 and one text summarization task Samsum.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance of our method on the test set using the exact match score and f1 score for the SQuAD v2 dataset and the ROUGE score for the Samsum dataset. Specifically, we follow the model‑based evaluation settings of ..., using COMET metrics for the translation tasks and the corresponding BLEU scores are also considered.
